name: @sesori/opencode-pr-monitor
description: opencode plugin and Claude Code plugin that watches GitHub PRs in the background and delivers factual [PR Monitor] reports into the owning session

scripts.build: esbuild claude-code/src/mcp-server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=claude-code/dist/mcp-server.mjs --log-level=warning --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
